description: Named himself and Somerset House, gave the five facts, and told him to mend his hose.
name: Ambrose Kettleby

description: Asked after the king, and kept the boys' five days inside the six pound.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Stood with Heminges and refused to spend the six pound in talk.
name: George Bryan

description: Said the matter twice, named the six pound and the shoes, and shut the book on the question.
name: John Heminges

description: Asked for the sending-for in plain words, and told him to keep the column empty.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Asked to hear the sentence twice, and remembered being paid before Easter.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Began to claim the first place, stopped, and gave it to the grocer.
name: Will Kemp

description: Wrote the line and struck the sum he had not written.
name: William Shakespeare
